description: This file contains several utility shell functions used for system management tasks such as process checking, MAC address retrieval, log synchronization, system reboot, and uptime measurement. It appears to be a collection of script functions for device and system management within an embedded or network device environment.

methods.name: processCheck
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given name is running; returns '1' if not running, '0' otherwise.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a specific network interface indicated by the variable ESTB_INTERFACE.

methods.name: syncLog
methods.description: Synchronizes log files from a temporary log directory to a persistent log directory, concatenating .txt and .log files.

methods.name: rebootFunc
methods.description: Performs a system reboot with pre-shutdown tasks including saving power state, syncing logs, and moving error/access logs.

methods.name: Uptime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds by reading /proc/uptime.
